dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: Someone not feeling in the mood to train today? ... You! Yes, you, blondie! You've clearly got a bit of an attitude about you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Me? I just want to praise our glorious cause!

dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: I'm not opposed to young people expressing themselves, but there's a time and a place. Our work here is too important to be overshadowed by explorations of individuality.

dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: Nevertheless, you remind me of myself when I was a fresh recruit. Keep training and don't you dare disappoint me!

dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: Right then, back to training, everyone! Prepare to head to your patrol stations — march in step!
